## Checklist

- [ ] I read [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and followed the coding style.
- [ ] I ran `bun run lint` and it's clean.
- [ ] I ran `bunx tsc --noEmit` and introduced no new TypeScript errors.
- [ ] I ran `bun run db:push` if I changed `prisma/schema.prisma`.
- [ ] I added or updated tests if my change is testable.
- [ ] I updated documentation (README, CHANGELOG, `docs/`, `skill/`) if behavior changed.
- [ ] I did **not** commit API keys, secrets, or `.env` files.
- [ ] I did **not** commit the local SQLite database (`db/custom.db`) or build artifacts (`.next/`).
